reviews.text: The entrance fee is a little expensive, but it's worth a visit if you like Lego. Various types of brick creations are displayed divided by theme, so you won't get bored. reviews.author: Beomsik Kim
reviews.text:
The exhibition was even better because the works made with LEGO were filled with a lot of effort and sincerity, and each work contained a story. An exhibition that not only children but also adults could enjoy. An exhibition where every nook and cranny was utilized well and the ideas really stood out. Personally, Harry Potter Hogwarts was the coolest and most memorable work.

Parking fee: 3,000 won for 2 hours at the goods shop
A parking ticket can be issued after eating at a restaurant in Galleria Foret. (Varies by restaurant)

reviews.author: Chainsaw Cho
reviews.text: I went there vaguely thinking that there would be various props made out of Lego, but I think I had more fun with it than my child. The reproductions of various works of art and landmarks were excellent, and the level of creative works of art was also extraordinary. In addition, I lost track of time as I watched the witty reinterpretations of pop culture, such as a reenactment of Marvel's Avengers' Endgame battle, an imaginary view of the interior of the Star Wars Death Star, Harry Potter's Hogwarts train station, and the Disney Princess Castle. And as a bonus, Lego-shaped chocolate is also recommended!

reviews.author: Boricom
reviews.text: Even adults who are not interested in Lego came and had fun looking around~^^ The works made with Lego were so cool! However, the parking fee is a little expensive... reviews.author: Leepicho
reviews.text:
I went because it was the last day of the Brick Campus Seoul discount coupon. The exhibition hall was interesting and there were many unique exhibits. The recreation of singer Seventeen's concert (Sangam World Cup Stadium) was amazing. It took about an hour to look through the exhibits, and then there was a place to play with blocks. Like a kids cafe, you can buy tea, Americano, block figure-shaped bread, block-shaped chocolate, and ice cream with chocolate blocks. There are several chairs and tables so you can sit and eat.
The downside is that there is no restroom inside, but if you go to the exit, you can get your ticket stamped and then re-enter. The restroom is close to the exit and you can re-enter through the exit, so you can re-enter and play and rest without having to go through the time-consuming exhibition hall.
You can also purchase parking for 3,000 won for 2 hours and pay an additional fee for extra hours.

reviews.author: GeonyoungLim
reviews.text:
A space where you can truly experience emotional eyewear in Seongsu.

This is a showroom operated by Kustom Eyewear, and is more like an ‘eyewear curation space’ than just a simple eyewear store.

The overall atmosphere feels structured and constructive. The rough concrete pillars and metallic materials work in harmony, showing the frame's original details more clearly.

I feel like the space itself speaks to the brand’s identity.

✔ Effector
A thick, masculine frame with the “Rock On The Eyewear” concept. The quality of the handmade products by craftsmen in Sabae, Japan is impressive.

✔ Yuichi Toyama
Understated neutral design. A brand that is simple but stands out for its structural beauty.

✔ A.D.S.R.
Contemporary eyewear with music and cultural mood. Trendy yet unique design.

✔ BAPE EYEWEAR
An eyewear line with a strong street sensibility. It is good as a fashion point item.

✔ grafik:plastic
The concept of ‘graphics on the face’. It's fun to customize the color by replacing the temples.

✔ Lucas de Stael
A high-end brand that combines leather with frames. Details that show the hand of a craftsman.

✔ Accrue Eyewear
Design based on artistic sensibility. Recommended if you like emotional mood.

• A selection with a distinct taste that is different from the typical brand composition.

• Each frame is displayed like a work of art, making it fun to look at.

• Attention to detail, even the scent of space
(The diffuser scent goes well with the space)

• A showroom that matches Seongsu’s unique sensibility

If you are interested in eyewear, this is a place worth visiting at least once.

If you stop by Seongsu, it's a place where you'll be satisfied even if you just take a quick look around.
